In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mode of interaction of Nd with glycine, l phenlyalanine and l alanine is through the carboxyl group, whereas the mode of interaction with l aspartic is through the amino group.
the mode of binding of Nd(III)-ligand is mainly covalent in nature and the interaction of Nd(II) with glycine is stronger than with the other ligands.
the interaction of the Nd(III) ion with glycine is through a bidentate mode with a chelate ring formation.
